summary: Electron is a well-supported recommendation for the current TypeScript/React/Nx repository because its Node main process can host the OpenCode TypeScript client and supervise the app-owned CLI sidecar within one trusted runtime. This is not a measured performance, size, security or Windows-runtime advantage. Tauri 2 remains a strong option with a Rust-owned host and target-specific sidecar packaging; retaining the TypeScript client there adds a trusted helper or requires a different HTTP client. Neutralinojs has explicit process APIs but requires application-owned extension/child cleanup. User choice remains open and implementation remains blocked.
evidence_gaps: No exact framework/OpenCode package compatibility or startup probe executed.
No package size, idle memory, security behavior, signing, native Windows launch, or lifecycle/reap behavior measured.
Official framework documentation establishes available APIs, not this application's effective security boundary.
